title: Written Contracts for Workers Covered under Employment of Foreign Manpower Act
what_it_is: Written Contracts for Workers Covered under Employment of Foreign Manpower Act

sections.label: Mandatory KETs contents
sections.summary: Mandatory KETs must be given within 14 days of employment start and include job title, duties, workplace, salary, leave, medical benefits, probation and notice period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The mandatory KETs, which must be provided within 14 days from the start of employment, include the job title, main duties and responsibilities, place of work, working arrangements, salary details, leave entitlements, medical benefits, probation and notice period.

sections.label: No downward salary revisions
sections.summary: Employers cannot make downward revisions to salary declared on the IPA unless they have the workers' written agreement and have notified the Ministry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employers are not allowed to make downward revisions to the workers’ salary information that was declared on the IPA, unless they have obtained the workers’ written agreement and notified the Ministry.

sections.label: SIP checks on IPA letters
sections.summary: Checks through SIPs from August to December 2019 showed 98% of foreign workers and almost all foreign domestic workers had complete IPA letters before coming to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our recent checks through the SIPs from August to December 2019 showed that 98% of foreign workers and almost all foreign domestic workers had the complete set of IPA letters with them before coming to Singapore.

sections.label: Reducing salary requires agreement
sections.summary: To reduce salary today, the employee must agree and the Ministry must be notified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Today, if you wish to reduce the salary, it has to be (a) with the agreement of the employee and (b) you have to notify the Ministry.

sections.label: 2% came without IPAs
sections.summary: The 2% was not the number that faced the problem but the number that came in without IPAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The 2% was not the number that faced the problem; rather, the 2% was the number that came in without IPAs.

sections.label: Enhanced SIP with NGOs
sections.summary: Workers now must come through SIP and spend a day with trainers, facilitators and onsite NGOs such as the Migrant Workers Centre, which conduct the SIPs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: What has been enhanced since then is that workers do have to come through SIP and they spend a day with not just the trainers, the facilitators, but there are also non-government organisations (NGOs) onsite like the Migrant Workers Centre, for example, which conduct the SIPs themselves.

sections.label: Expanded SIPs for vulnerable sectors
sections.summary: The main recent difference is that SIPs are now in place and have been expanded, especially for the most vulnerable sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The main difference in the last few months is that the SIPs are now in place and we have expanded them, especially for sectors that are most vulnerable.

sections.label: SIPs require IPAs
sections.summary: Today, they cannot complete their SIPs if they do not come in with IPAs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Today, they cannot complete their SIPs if they do not come in with IPAs.
